observation: RIG-14: opened via the map shortcut rather than a bare game_menu press. The pause shell REOPENS ON THE LAST TAB USED, so a fixed press count from an assumed backpack start lands on the wrong tab in any segment that opens the menu more than once -- this segment's own Section E.5 map-navigation notes leave the shell on `menu_map`, so the bare `open_menu` + `times: 5` this step used before landed on the wrong tab, the Save button was never actually focused, and `save_out` then copied out whatever was already seeded in slot 4 under this segment's own name -- the exact mechanism RIG-10 named without yet fixing. `map` is one of only two tabs with a shortcut in data/config/menu.json, so it is the only deterministic starting point available. Matches S03/S06/S08's own working save steps.
